propositions: A new advisory code-review overlay (surface-parity) must fire when a write-op parameter, guard, or required-field surface changes on one adapter (lib, CLI, MCP) without sibling adapters being updated in lockstep.

The overlay is glob-triggered on the three write-surface adapter files (_commands/*, _lib_writes.py, _mcp_writes.py) and must be wired into round_a and round_b batches of the four-pass code-review gate so the finder is actually dispatched.

The overlay operates in advisory mode (blocking_enabled=false, block_threshold=0.95) and must NOT fire for deliberate justified divergences (adapter-bound non-caller-visible params like _creation_channel, return_alias, source, repo_root; internal-only refactors changing no caller-visible surface).

The packaged reviewer prompt must enumerate the three write surfaces, carry false-positive guards, and produce findings with criteria=[surface-parity] matching the deletion-impact/api-compat contract.
